method: Each study was planned by splicr.ingest.design.plan_study from live ENA filereport + GEO SOFT metadata. The correct design was written by hand from the GEO sample titles, characteristics and series overall design. A role is "confident" when its confidence >= 0.8 (the ready bar); lower-confidence roles block readiness and are counted as abstentions. Development studies were used while writing and fixing the rules, so their numbers are optimistic; the 10 held-out studies were planned once with the code frozen and are the honest estimate.

wrong_but_ready_found_and_fixed_during_d.error: ready with one Cellosaurus RRID (THP-1) although half the runs are iPSC-derived macrophages (iMAC): the unresolvable second cell line was silently dropped
wrong_but_ready_found_and_fixed_during_d.fix: any study stating more than one distinct cell line is needs_review, checked before resolution

wrong_but_ready_found_and_fixed_during_d.error: ready with each background's T1 compared against the library-only T0 instead of its own matched T0 (T0/T1 glued into the sample token split the contexts)
wrong_but_ready_found_and_fixed_during_d.fix: strip a glued time point from context tokens; falling back to a context-free reference while context-specific references exist is now a blocking issue

known_failure_modes: Unresolved agents block: TAK243 (25 nM), Nutlin3R 10 uM, AMA, CC-122, DHT, TMZ are not matched to ChEMBL (dose text and abbreviations are not normalised), so those arms abstain.
"control for <drug>" sample names (GSE150232) read as naming the drug; the control arms abstain rather than being placed.
Lane regex also matches sample-sheet names like "Ln2S6_L002" when each sample is a single run (GSE216087): a false blocking issue.
The "primary cells" check matches words such as "in vivo" / "mice" in the study summary, so screens in cell lines whose paper mentions in vivo validation are blocked (GSE112734).
Combination-treatment arms (venetoclax + ruxolitinib) land in a separate stratum without their own vehicle and get no contrast.
Runs of one GSM split across several SRRs, and lane-split samples, always block: the plan cannot express per-sample FASTQ merging.
Multi-cell-line and multi-modality studies always block (by design): one plan carries one cell line RRID and one modality.

A sorted comparison population named as a bin (CD58-mid, GSE225235) is read as a treatment bin, not as the control the authors intended; an intermediate pre-sort time point (day 6) is read as a control rather than an early reference.
Replicate-by-day designs (GSE217789: days 17/18/19 are replicates) are split into per-day 1-vs-1 contrasts.
